name: salesgrid-android
description: Capacitor Android shell for SalesGrid. Loads the deployed SalesGrid web app over HTTPS; all business logic stays on the server.

scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.bundle:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
